thread:
olivia: @channel GA: Hosted Gen API v3 is live. Streaming + tool-calling are production. New model variants: redwood-aurora-2 (balanced quality), mosaic-mini-quant (ultra cost). Deprecation: legacy /v2 gen endpoints retire in 90 days. :tada:

kevin: Rollout plan: fast canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% over ~3h with health gates. Watch GPU mem and preemptions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for gen-pool-1 at 1860004380

anya: SRE: dashboards added (gen.latency.p50/p95, toolcall.err_rate, stream.session_errors). Alerts: p95 > 700ms or toolcall.err_rate > 0.8% -> page. Synthetic streaming checks every 60s.

marta: Docs preview up (migration guide + examples): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3-ga (pr #512). SDK patches for streaming helpers landing shortly.

sam: Legal: tool-calling requires customers declare external tool scopes in console; privacy update staged.

kevin: No auth changes. New optional params: model_variant, streaming=true, allow_tool_calls=true. Quick curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/gen -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"model":"redwood-aurora-2","streaming":true,"input":"Summarize the spec"}'
```

olivia: Migration: console banners + emails tomorrow. Recommend mosaic-mini-quant as fallback for cost-sensitive routes. Rollback: flip routing flag -> route to v2 traffic group; estimated rollback < 30m.

marta: Ping me for any doc fixes.

kevin: Canary keys for testers: DM me for X-Canary-Key.

olivia: Thanks team. Ops will monitor first 6 hours closely. If you see anomalies ping #eng-oncall and tag @anya. Celebrate! :rocket:
